metadata.title: When Valorant Gave Me 2 Kills and I Was Just Trying To Find The Bathroom LOL
metadata.description:
Wait, why am I suddenly a threat?
Enemy probably AFK or checking their snap.
Click if your aim’s a mess but you still steal kills.
Valorant logic doing its usual weird favors.

Tap if your best kills come from pure confusion!

#valorant #funnygaming #luckshot #gamingfails #shorts
